title: Chocolate Coconut Squares
hookLine: Australian-inspired chocolate coconut squares with 11 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Butter and line the base of a 20cm square baking tin. Beat together the butter and sugar until pale and creamy, then beat in the eggs. Add 1 tbsp of the flour if the mix starts to curdle. Incorporate {m53101_1}, {m53101_2}, {m53101_3}, and {m53101_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Sieve in the flour, baking powder and cocoa and fold in with a metal spoon. Stir in the milk. Scrape mix into the tin and level the top. Bake for 18-20 mins or until the cake springs back when pressed. Allow to cool in the tin. Incorporate {m53101_5}, {m53101_6}, {m53101_7}, {m53101_8}, {m53101_9}, {m53101_10}, and {m53101_11} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the icing, put the chocolate, butter and 4 tbsp water in a pan and gently heat until melted. Allow to cool slightly, then beat in the icing sugar.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove cake from tin and peel away paper. Cut into 16 squares. Dip the squares into the icing, then roll in the coconut. Allow to set on cooling rack.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
